import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MAXN = 1000005;
    static final long MOD = 998244353;
    static final long MODD = 1000000007;
    static final long INF = 1000000000000000000L;
    static long[] st = new long[15];
    static String[] good = new String[(int)MAXN];
    static int N;
    static int number;
    static List<String>[] lenn = new ArrayList[7];
    static List<Integer>[][] ok = new ArrayList[7][7];
    static long[][] sum = new long[7][7];
    static String s;
    static int n;

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            lenn[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <=6; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 7; j++) {
                ok[i][j] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
        }
    }

    static long goal(String s) {
        long answ = 0;
        for (char c : s.toCharArray()) {
            answ = answ * 10 + (c - '0');
        }
        return answ;
    }

    static long getCur(String cur, int max_len) {
        if (max_len == -1) return 0;
        int L = max_len / 2;
        int R = max_len - L;
        if (max_len == 1) {
            L = 1; R = 0;
        }
        long ans = (number - goal(cur) + MOD * MOD) % MOD;
        number++;
        for (String lef : lenn[L]) {
            ans += ((-goal(cur + lef) + number + MOD * MOD) % MOD);
            long c = goal(cur + lef) % MOD;
            if (lef.length() == L) {
                long cst = ((-c + MOD) + MOD) % MOD;
                int to = Collections.binarySearch(ok[R][lef.length()], (int) (MOD - cst));
                if (to < 0) to = -to - 1;
                else to = to + 1;
                ans += ok[R][lef.length()].size() * cst + sum[R][lef.length()] - MOD * (ok[R][lef.length()].size() - to);
                number += lenn[R].size();
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        // Read input
        n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
        N = String.valueOf(n).length();
        for (int i = 1; i <= 14; i++) {
            st[i] = st[i - 1] * 10;
        }
        s = String.valueOf(n);
        StringBuilder cur = new StringBuilder();

        // Initialize good strings and lenn
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
            good[i] = String.valueOf(i);
            String now = good[i];
            while (now.length() <= 6) {
                lenn[now.length()].add(now);
                now = "0" + now;
            }
        }

        // Build lenn and ok structures
        for (int i = 1; i <= 6; i++) {
            for (String key : lenn[i - 1]) {
                lenn[i].add(key);
            }
            Collections.sort(lenn[i]);
            for (int j = 0; j < lenn[i].size(); j++) {
                String keyStr = lenn[i].get(j);
                int lenKey = keyStr.length();
                int keyVal = (int) ((goal(keyStr) - goal("0")) % MOD); // just placeholder, adapt as needed
                ok[i][lenKey].add((int)((-goal(keyStr) + MOD) % MOD));
            }
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                Collections.sort(ok[i][j]);
                for (Integer key : ok[i][j]) {
                    sum[i][j] += key;
                }
            }
        }

        // Generate all Q
        List<Pair> Q = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= 9; j++) {
                if (j == s.charAt(i) - '0') continue;
                if (i == 0 && j == 0) continue;
                StringBuilder newCur = new StringBuilder(cur);
                newCur.append((char) ('0' + j));
                String newStr = newCur.toString();
                int lenRem = s.length() - i - 1;
                if (j > s.charAt(i) - '0') lenRem--;
                Q.add(new Pair(newStr, lenRem));
                // no need to pop as StringBuilder's new instance created
            }
            StringBuilder newCur = new StringBuilder(cur);
            newCur.append(s.charAt(i));
            Q.add(new Pair(newCur.toString(), 0));
            cur = new StringBuilder(newCur);
        }

        number = 1;
        long ans = 0;
        Collections.sort(Q);
        for (Pair key : Q) {
            if (s.charAt(key.first.length() - 1) == key.first.charAt(key.first.length() - 1)) {
                ans += ((-goal(key.first) + number + MOD * MOD) % MOD);
                number++;
                continue;
            }
            ans += getCur(key.first, key.second);
        }
        ans %= MODD;
        System.out.println(ans);
    }

    static class Pair implements Comparable<Pair> {
        String first;
        int second;

        Pair(String f, int s) {
            first = f;
            second = s;
        }

        @Override
        public int compareTo(Pair o) {
            return first.compareTo(o.first);
        }
    }
}
